title.zh: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B
title.en: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B

current_state.zh: Kalshi closed a $1 billion Series G round at a $40 billion valuation, co-led by Wellington Management and Sequoia Capital, and said its non-sports markets now generate more than $1 billion in annualized revenue as it expands into financial markets and deepens NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices partnerships while contesting legal challenges to its sports contracts.
